Name: StardewSaveLauncher
Author: slpOff
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Stardew Save Launcher[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Stardew Save Launcher[/b] is a desktop launcher for Stardew Valley that manages mod sets and starts SMAPI with the selected save and mod set.

Instead of manually moving folders in and out of Mods
, the launcher builds a dedicated Runtime/Mods environment and links only the mods needed for the current launch.

It supports Common mods, mod sets, save selection, Nexus update checks, and translation file imports from one UI.


[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] Save file list[/*]
[*]Mod selection per mod set[/*]
[*]Common mods shared by every mod set[/*]
[*]SMAPI launch with the selected save and mod set[/*]
[*]Runtime Mods generation based on selected mods and dependencies[/*]
[*]Companion SMAPI mod for automatic save loading[/*]
[*]Nexus Mods update checks[/*]
[*]Launcher self-update checks[/*]
[*]Mod and mod pack folder import[/*]
[*]Translation folder import[/*]
[*]SMAPI log and launcher error log access[/*]
[*]macOS and Windows support[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Install and Run[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]macOS[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] Download and extract
[code]StardewSaveLauncher-2.1.0-osx-arm64.zip[/code].[/*]
[*]Move
[code]Stardew Save Launcher.app[/code]to Applications or any folder you prefer.[/*]
[*]Launch the app.[/*]
[*]If macOS blocks the app, allow it from [b]System Settings > Privacy & Security[/b].[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Windows[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] Download and extract
[code]StardewSaveLauncher-2.1.0-win-x64.zip[/code].[/*]
[*]Run
[code]Start Stardew Save Launcher.cmd[/code]inside the extracted folder.[/*]
[*]The launcher UI opens automatically in your browser.[/*]
[*]If Windows shows a security warning, allow the app to run.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]macOS or Windows[/*]
[*]Nexus Mods Personal API Key [i](for Nexus update checks)[/i][/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Initial Setup[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] Check paths in the [b]HOME[/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Set these paths manually if needed:
[list]
[*] Stardew Valley path[/*]
[*]SMAPI executable path[/*]
[*]Saves path[/*]
[*]Mods path[/*]
[*]Runtime path[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Select a save.[/*]
[*]Select a mod set tab.[/*]
[*]Click [b]Play[/b].[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Basic Usage[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]HOME Tab[/b][/size]

The [b]HOME[/b] tab contains launcher settings and maintenance actions.

[list]
[*] Game, SMAPI, save, mods, and runtime path settings[/*]
[*]Nexus API key input[/*]
[*]Nexus update check[/*]
[*]Launcher update check[/*]
[*]Open launcher error log folder[/*]
[*]Open SMAPI log[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Save List[/b][/size]

The left sidebar is fixed to the save file list.

When you select a save, its name appears in the header.


[size=4][b]Mod Set Tabs[/b][/size]

The top tab bar contains [b]HOME[/b], [b]Common[/b], and each individual mod set.

[b]Common[/b] is used to manage mods that should be shared across every mod set.

Other tabs represent individual mod sets. In these tabs, you can select additional mods that should only be used with that specific mod set.

Mods included in [b]Common[/b] are automatically added to every mod set and hidden from the other mod set lists.


[size=4][b]Play / Replay[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] [b]Play[/b]: Builds Runtime Mods for the current save and mod set, then starts SMAPI.[/*]
[*][b]Replay[/b]: Stops the running game and starts it again using the same launch flow.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Importing Mods[/b][/size]

Use the drop zone or the [b]Browse[/b] button in a mod set tab to add mods.

[list]
[*] A folder containing
[code]manifest.json[/code]is treated as a mod or mod pack.[/*]
[*]If you select a parent folder containing multiple mods, the folder structure is preserved.[/*]
[*]The success toast shows the actual copied path.[/*]
[*]If a folder with the same name as the selected mod set exists, it is used first. Otherwise, files are installed into the Mods path.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Importing Translation Files[/b][/size]

If the selected folder does [b]not[/b] contain
[code]manifest.json[/code], the launcher treats it as a translation folder.

[list=1]
[*] Select the translation folder using the [b]Browse[/b] button or drop zone.[/*]
[*]A searchable modal appears. Choose the mod that the translation belongs to.[/*]
[*]The launcher copies the translation files into the selected mod's
[code]i18n[/code]folder or matching translation file paths.[/*]
[*]Existing translation files at the target path are overwritten.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Nexus Mods Update Checks[/b][/size]

Nexus update checks require a [b]Personal API Key[/b].

[b]How to create an API key:[/b]

[list=1]
[*] Log in to Nexus Mods.[/*]
[*]Click your profile icon.[/*]
[*]Open [b]Site Preferences[/b].[/*]
[*]Go to the [b]API[/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Generate and copy your [b]Personal API key[/b].[/*]
[*]Paste it into the [b]Nexus API Key[/b] field in the launcher HOME tab.[/*]
[/list]
The launcher uses the Stardew Valley domain by default, so there is no separate game field.


[size=5][b]Logs[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] [b]SMAPI Log[/b]: Opens the
[code]SMAPI-latest.txt[/code]file generated by SMAPI.[/*]
[*][b]Launcher Error Log[/b]: Opens the folder containing
[code]launcher-errors.txt[/code], which records launcher client/server errors.[/*]
[/list]
If something breaks, check the [b]Launcher Error Log[/b] button in the HOME tab first.
